name: Mina Harper
source: Mina is a young and shy receptionist at the Dale-ly Apartments. She has a hard time connecting with her peers, so she communicates with the hotel's residents most of the time. Mina works to save up for a trip worldwide and is willing to do whatever it takes to get a promotion.
